programs.description: When Jayanthi's husband, Ramesh, who is accused in a gold smuggling case, goes missing, she comes to Kochi to find him. In her quest to locate him, she comes across Raju, a taxi driver.
Pavithran, a dramatist, goes to a village for inspiration for writing a play. When he comes across Alli, a young woman who is deep in debt, he decides to learn her story for his play.
Aravindan, a Chakyar Koothu artist from a village, gets married to Aswathy, who lives in a city. The whole village decides to accompany him to attend his marriage.
Sadasivan comes across a house where the owner, Kumaran, has committed suicide to protect his wife, Soumini. However, what is even stranger is that a man who is visually challenged is always around.

A comprehensive compilation of some of the best rib-tickling comedy scenes from various Malayalam movies featuring renowned actors and actresses.
Worried about their son's future, Eyo's parents arrange his marriage with a divorced millionaire. However, unexpected events follow when he realises he has erectile dysfunction on his wedding night.
Gautham is a young and successful businessman. His life dramatically changes when he meets Nithya, a girl who is suffering from short-term memory loss.

Premachandran, a carpenter, rescues Kanmani, an ill-treated maid, and takes her into his care. However, to escape from her former abusers, Kanmani dresses up as a boy and joins the team of carpenters.
Siddharth and Kalli never seem to be short on money. However, when they meet the women of their dreams, they are pushed into reconsidering their career choices.
When the daughter of a minister gets kidnapped, Christy is called upon to rescue her. Although he manages to save her, he himself gets embroiled in the kidnapper's murder.
Narayanan, who gets convicted for killing his father, returns from prison to his village and works selflessly for its people. However, his vengeful relatives create obstacles for him.

En route to Bangalore, a man falls in love with a beautiful girl. But he soon realises that her father was responsible for the death of his sister during a terrorist attack a long time ago.
Monayi goes to the city to stay with his friend. However, he ends up getting involved in problems which turns chaotic for everyone.
A patriarch of a royal family goes on a mission to find the murderers responsible for killing his descendant. He takes the help of his nephews who are police officers.
Thomas Kutty buys a haunted bungalow and convinces his friends to stay with him on the first night. The trouble begins when they actually see the ghost of the mistress who was killed 70 years ago.
Pulikkattil, an affluent family man, is forced to bear the brunt and burden of his late father's unscrupulous past. Now, Karnan, a jail convict, decides to settle some old scores with him.
Jaison, a young tailor, gains superpowers after being struck by lightning. However, he must thwart the evil intentions of an unexpected adversary to become the superhero that his rural village needs.
Mathimaran, an honest journalist, exposes a fraud by Pazhani, a politician. As a result, it lands his career in trouble, while also threatening his family's safety.
Determined to catch a notorious criminal, a police officer and his team undergoes several challenges as they scale the lengths of the country.
Four misfits navigate societal and parental pressures as they enter adulthood. Subsequently, their heartfelt journey of self-discovery proves that love and acceptance always triumph over judgment.

When Maradonna, a reckless youth, becomes entangled with drug traffickers and faces financial ruin, a celestial intervention thwarts his suicidal intentions.
Mahadevan is a live witness of Radhika's hit-and-run accident. His helpful gesture of taking Radhika to the hospital, however, lands him in trouble when he is confronted by Meera, Radhika's friend.
Narayan's mother separated from her Brahmin husband years ago. But Narayan sets out to find him, in order to uncover his own identity in the society.
Inspired by Sherlock Holmes, an IRS officer, resolves to employ his analytical prowess in tackling an extensive criminal operation.
When Karkotakudu, a monster, attempts to destroy Earth to take control of the planet, Rajeshwari, a devotee of Goddess Akkamma, decides to fight the behemoth.

Apoorvan, a school dropout, aspires to become a renowned scientist and tries various experiments. While his friends Babumon and Chopra help him, the three often land in trouble due to their behaviour.
A group of college friends meet after many years for a class reunion. However, due to some unexpected turn of events, several dark secrets are revealed, which changes their lives.
Stephen Nedumpally, a mystifying leader of the crime world, must lead a double life to protect his world by rekindling some old memories.
Vincent Kombana, a parish priest, is highly respected by the people of his village. However, things take an unusual turn after he witnesses a murder.
Vincent Kombana, a parish priest, is highly respected by the people of his village. However, things take an unusual turn after he witnesses a murder.
Manu, Meera, Rafeeq, Ashok and Vijayakumar study together in a college. The five friends share a close bond and are always willing to fight for each other.
Friends Chacko and Hari are fed up with their employer and plan a trip to Goa. Their trip turns into something unusual when they discover a mysterious bag.
Best friends Neelima and Aisha, who study in the same college, befriend fellow students Karthik and Kunjumon. Later, Neelima falls in love with Karthik and helps him through Aisha discreetly.
As Venu's dream is to secure an MBBS admission for his daughter, he decides to sell his property to get money for her education. However, his family members try to disrupt his plans.
Menon buys land for his five-star hotel and asks his trusted employee, Sreedharan Unnithan, to take its charge. Years later, Unnithan gets Menon imprisoned in a fake case and Kunjumon helps him.
Mathews owns a farm that is the envy of everyone in the village. It attracts the attention of a dirty land dealer, who entangles him in a vicious bureaucratic web to take it away from him.
A senior cop and a new recruit are forced to work together through a tense night shift, confronting danger and personal dilemmas that reveal deep cracks in the system.
An unexpected twist in the tale of taxi driver Shanmughan's life puts his fondness for his old car to the ultimate test.
Major Mukund Varadarajan, a commissioned officer in the Rajput Regiment of the Indian Army, conducts a counterterrorism operation while being deployed to Jammu and Kashmir.

Prabhakaran, a Gandhian panchayat member, fights corruption in Thonnurkara village. However, his crusade for people's welfare angers corrupt politicians.
After reading the works written by Balachandran, a publisher encourages him to publish a book. However, he struggles a lot as he faces a writer's block.
For TV director Thomaskutty Pachu, nothing is more stressful than dealing with his pesky cousin Joseph Kovalan. That is, until a murder occurs on the set.
In the 1960s, when interreligious marriages were still taboo, Moideen and Kanchanamala fell in love. Even after being forced to part ways, the two lovers fight for their undying love.
A team of police constables from Kerala arrive in a town in Chhattisgarh for their election duty. Soon, they must survive in the Maoist-affected area using minimal ammunition.
Sreekumar comes across a girl while visiting his childhood friend, Govindan Kutty. However, he later realises that she is the spirit of a student who disappeared a while ago.
Lovers Sufi and Sujata are forced to separate due to their religions. Years later, Sujata receives a phone call that intertwines their lives again.
Gopalakrishnan meets Veena while trying to smuggle a stolen necklace. Later, he accompanies Veena on her mission to unite with her lover.
Kasi and Suni decide to go on a road trip from Kerala to Nagaland in search of Kasi's girlfriend. On their way, they experience several life-defining moments.

Seelabhati along with her mother visits a remote village where she starts working as a computer teacher. When some students mysteriously disappear, the villagers start blaming her educational course.
Chanchala, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.

Rajan, a policeman, goes after a powerful criminal but ends up losing his wife and is also left crippled. Soon, he becomes a jailer and recruits four vigilantes to trap the kingpin who ruined his life.
When a family of four sets out on a road trip, they are accompanied by two girls on their way. However, things take an unexpected turn when one of the girls is found dead.
Sathya is a poor man in search of his sister, who has been kidnapped by human traffickers. However, an illegal brain transplant puts him in the shoes of a billionaire named Vijay.
Viju, a motivational speaker, is hired to be the face of a religious scam for which he undergoes rigorous training. As his popularity grows, he sinks into the depths of darkness and delusion.
Trapped in a bitterly cold place, Helen holds on for dear life even as hope starts fading away. Meanwhile, her worried father Paul races against time to track her down.
Two close friends, John and Kurian, wish to take their friendship one step further and get their children married. However, they are unaware of the lives their children lead in the city.
The life of struggling news anchor, Engels Ramaswamy, and his family changes when a goddess appears before them. Later, with the help of the goddess, Engels sets out to expose fake godmen.

Kasim Bhai is found murdered. The suspicion falls on the Kaladarshana team and the unfolding of the murder mystery forms the rest of the story.
A wealthy heiress plans to implicate her former boyfriend for her murder by hiring an assassin. Things take a turn when a thief enters the house at the same time.
A man with mental challenges decides to join a martial arts school in order to hone his fighting skills and avenge the murder of his sister.
Dr. Rajalakshmi enjoys life with her two daughters, Pinki and Pooja. However, when she uncovers a major pharmaceutical fraud, she becomes the target of dangerous enemies determined to silence her.
Sagunan always underestimates his wife and never appreciates her work. However, due to an unexpected turn of events, he ends up realising the value of not only his wife, but women in general.
Ajayan comes back to his village to be with his ailing mother. However, things get strange when a boy comes to his house claiming to be his son.
Two colleges participate in a youth festival. Gauthaman represents Maharaja college whereas Irene represents all-time winners, St Teresa's College.
A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.
Kalidas, a motivational speaker, is bound to stay home due to the COVID-19 pandemic lockdown. Soon, he starts experiencing paranormal activities in his home.

Lakshmanan, an advocate specialising in women's divorce cases, ties the knot with Annie. However, trouble ensues when her hidden agenda emerges.
Manoharan leads a peaceful life with his family. However, fear engulfs him when he realises that a sketch of a wanted terrorist resembles him.
Devan, an orphan, drinks an invisibility potion and sets out to rescue Maya, a journalist who is raising him, after she is kidnapped by an influential man.
Kalasadhan Ullas is an aspiring stage singer looking for his big break. However, his life is turned upside down when an opportunistic woman and her father target him for a nefarious purpose.
Ittymaani, who was raised in China, runs a business of counterfeit products in India. However, when he tries to help Annamma who is ignored by her sons, he lands in trouble because she falls ill.
Four people, a supermarket employee, a little girl, a housewife and a college student, deal with their everyday problems in life and try their best to overcome them.
The exiled prince Raghav embarks on a perilous journey to rescue his wife, Janaki, from the clutches of the demon king Lankesh. He must gather an army to wage an epic battle against evil forces.
Robert, Dony and Xavier grow up together while honing their fighting skills. However, after an incident separates them for several years, an attack on their family reunites the three friends.
Baba Kalyani, a police officer, travels to Kochi to uncover a terrorist conspiracy. He must not only work on the case but also deal with old rivals who are hell-bent on settling scores with him.
